verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for an agent-building SDK, but the evidence pack documents no first-party versioning, change review, or rollback of agents or workflows. Tracing reviews run events, and human-in-the-loop approval pauses individual tool calls. Both are adjacent features, not version control of automations, and keeping agent code in git would be a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
